name: cravo-food-delivery
description: Full-stack food delivery platform with microservices architecture

scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others --names "FRONTEND,AUTH,REALTIME,RESTAURANT,RIDER,UTILS,ADMIN" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgRed.bold,bgWhite.bold" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd services/auth && npm run dev" "cd services/realtime && npm run dev" "cd services/restaurant && npm run dev" "cd services/rider && npm run dev" "cd services/utils && npm run dev" "cd services/admin && npm run dev"
scripts.install: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../services/auth && npm install && cd ../restaurant && npm install && cd ../rider && npm install && cd ../realtime && npm install && cd ../utils && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../services/auth && npm run build && cd ../restaurant && npm run build && cd ../rider && npm run build && cd ../realtime && npm run build && cd ../utils && npm run build && cd ../admin && npm run build
